name: Cascade Data Center Cooling Failure Scenario
description: Scripted telemetry scenario demonstrating k-of-n redundancy absorption followed by secondary cascade failure.

events.description: All 3 chillers operational, loop flow 350 L/min, hall temp 21.5°C, UPS panels 55% balanced.
Chiller CH-2 trips offline. Redundancy check: 2 of 3 chillers (CH-1, CH-3) remain operational (k_required=2). System state: DEGRADED. No cascade triggered.
Power transient on UPS Panel B trips CH-1 (dependent per D6). Only 1 chiller (CH-3) remains where 2 required. K-of-N breached! Thermal runaway begins.
EWMA z-score exceeds 3.0 on PT-LOOP-FLOW and PT-HALL-TEMP for 3 consecutive samples. Incident created. Nemotron agent triggered unprompted.
Hall 200 inlet temperature reaches 32.5°C (> critical limit 32°C). Acme Cloud Services SLA breached (D9). SLA credit counter begins ($4,500/hr credit tier).
